question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, birth_date
  FROM mst_users
),
user_ages AS (
  SELECT user_id, birth_date,
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM users
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    CASE
      WHEN age >= 20 AND age <= 29 THEN '20s'
      WHEN age >= 30 AND age <= 39 THEN '30s'
      WHEN age >= 40 AND age <= 49 THEN '40s'
      WHEN age >= 50 AND age <= 59 THEN '50s'
      ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category
  FROM user_ages
)
SELECT
  age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM categorized
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY
  CASE age_category
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2
    WHEN '40s' THEN 3
    WHEN '50s' THEN 4
    WHEN 'others' THEN 5
  END
